query.name: command-build-list
query.sql: SELECT build.id AS id, build.number AS number, project.name AS name, build.pass_count AS pass_count, build.fail_count AS fail_count FROM porion_build AS build INNER JOIN porion_project AS project ON build.project_id = project.id
query.sql-count: SELECT count(build.id) FROM porion_build AS build
